instruction: Navigate to View > Master Slides, select the slide number element, and apply italic formatting using the toolbar button

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate to master slides view and apply italic formatting to the slide number placeholder. The evaluator verifies the italic formatting by parsing the slide master XML and checking for the italic attribute (i='1') in the text run properties.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking italic formatting on slide number element in master slides
Getter logic is correct: retrieves .pptx file from VM with proper postconfig (Ctrl+S to save changes)
Metric logic is semantically correct: parses slideMaster1.xml, finds slide number placeholder (ph_type='sldNum'), and checks for italic attribute (i='1') in text run properties
Data flow is correct: pptx file -> XML parsing -> italic attribute check -> score (1.0 if found, 0.0 otherwise)
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Parameter handling is acceptable: metric receives empty rules dict but doesn't need it since the task only checks for presence of italic formatting
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Add explicit error logging to distinguish between different failure modes (file not found, XML parsing error, etc.) instead of catching all exceptions silently
Minor: Consider validating that slideMaster1.xml exists before parsing, though this is unlikely to be an issue with LibreOffice Impress files
